description: Retrieval baseline for colpali-rag (Qdrant local mode, RRF-60 hybrid). Dev set: evals/golden_queries.json (10 hand-checked queries over 8 indexed pages across 3 PDFs). All scores are hit@k / mrr@10 / ndcg@5 with binary relevance against the gold (src, page).
notes: hybrid == colpali == perfect MRR/NDCG; dense text leg is the weakest (2 golds at rank 1, chart/figure-heavy queries). RRF fusion lifts every query to rank 0.
Scores are ceiling-limited: 8 indexed pages is a small corpus; grow the dev set toward 30-100 queries before relying on the absolute numbers.
Per-query detail (ranks, hits) is archived under evals/results/<mode>.json. Re-run with: uv run python -m colpali_rag.eval --mode hybrid --out evals/results/hybrid.json
